The test failed with an AssertionError in the 'Part_Results' sheet at cell R6C10 (Row 6, Column 10). 

Expected: 'Crates_Required_Rounded_Up'
Actual: 'Units_Per_Crate'

This indicates a column header mismatch in the 14-column header row (Row 6) of the 'Part_Results' sheet. The Planner must ensure the columns are ordered exactly as defined in the specification. Based on the trace, 'Units_Per_Crate' was placed where 'Crates_Required_Rounded_Up' was expected.
reasoning: The trace provides a specific coordinate (R6C10) and the exact string mismatch, which is the direct cause of the reward being 0.0. Pointing this out allows the Planner to correct the header array.
